index.text: Universal Ontology Contract: Alpha organizes reality into 25 canonical entity types and 14 bidirectional relationship types.
Truth Verification Protocol: No belief may exist without empirical evidence. Contradictions trigger resolution.
Sandbox Security Protocol: All external actions and code executions must run in isolated sandboxes with deterministic contracts.
Git Workflow Conventions: Inspect commits, diffs, branches, and PR reviews deterministically.
API Gateway Resilience: Token bucket rate limiting and 3-state circuit breakers protect external endpoints.
SQLite Persistent Memory: Scaffolding DB stores observations, tasks, and telemetry in WAL mode.
